liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **They Love Each Other** (2 reviews): Keith's solos are especially groovy in this 1978 version; Reviewer judges Jerry's guitar work here the best They Love Each Other ever [6][9]
- **Lazy Lightnin'** (2 reviews): Described as a monster version leading into Supplication; Reviewer calls the Lazy Lightning into Supplication the most intense they have heard [5][6]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer says this Sugaree is probably the best you will ever hear [11]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): An M-80 was thrown about 1:46 into the song, a memorable moment for attendees [15]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Called one of the best 1978 versions, with a ripping, extended jam following a strong Ship of Fools [5]
- **Iko Iko** (1 review): Reviewer found Iko Iko slightly off [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-07-05.sonyecm54p.wagner.97299.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 172 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd78-07-05.sony.wiley.11481.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 144 min; rated 4/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds decent, capable of capturing the show's magic; Clear source; reviewer considers trying a pitch fix [7][8]
- **gd1978-07-05.fob.knight.motb-0070.91786.flac24**: source not stated; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Recording was paused between most songs, with crossfades applied; first beats of Sugaree and Beat It On Down The Line missing [3]
- **gd1978-07-05.fob.knight.motb-0070.91785.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 3.6/5 by 10 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with full sound, thick bass and good instrument separation, fairly good for its era; Excellent audience sound; Jerry's guitar sounds especially good on Eyes of the World; Recording was paused between most songs, with crossfades applied; first beats of Sugaree and Beat It On Down The Line missing [4][12][16]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's parents recall an M-80 firecracker thrown during Ship of Fools, about 1:46 in [15]
- First set has the same licks as the Red Rocks run beginning two days later [5]
- Reviewer finds more charisma here than in the two following Red Rocks shows, though not perfect [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-07-05.sonyecm54p.wagner.97299.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by David Minches; source: 2 Sony ECM-54 Ps >Sony 158 [1]. Also: Encore comes from an alternate source: Senn 441s mono single mic, reel master to PCM; speed corrected by Joe B. Jones [1]
- **gd78-07-05.sony.wiley.11481.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sony 54P's [2]. Also: Audience tape using Sony 54P mics into Sony TC-158, then to DAT and CD, via Paul B; seeded by T. Wiley [2]
- **gd1978-07-05.fob.knight.motb-0070.91786.flac24**: taped by Timothy Knight; transferred by Adam Egert and Derek McCabe; source: Unknown Mircophones => Unknown Sony Tape Deck [Patch] => Nakamichi 550 [Dolby Encode] >> MAC [3]. Also: Taped from the middle of the floor, roughly 15 to 20 feet from the front of stage [3]
- **gd1978-07-05.fob.knight.motb-0070.91785.flac16**: taped by Timothy Knight; transferred by Adam Egert and Derek McCabe; source: Unknown Mircophones => Unknown Sony Tape Deck [Patch] => Nakamichi 550 [Dolby Encode] >> MAC [4]. Also: Taped from the middle of the floor, roughly 15 to 20 feet from the front of stage [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Paul Pope Intro: [Grateful Dead - July 1978 - The Complete Recordings (2016 12 CD Boxset -includes Booklet, numbered 13940/15000 EX/EX)](https://therecordcentre.com/grateful-dead-july-1978-the-complete-recordings-2016-12-cd-boxset-includes-booklet-numbered-13940-15000-ex-ex/) [23]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 7/5/78 Omaha Civic Center, Omaha, NE (back… | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27305892076/) [24]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27305892076/) [25]
